title: Reasoning from stated conditions
bodyMd: A voucher is redeemable if and only if it is unused and has not expired. Rowan’s voucher is unused but expired. Noor’s voucher is unused and unexpired. A third voucher’s status is not described.
accessibilityText: Read the accompanying original prose passage. All information needed for the questions is in the passage.
